title: Param Renames: --zuidstring → --zuid, --new-name → --to, --wait-ms → --drain-timeout
description: Rename three poorly-named flags across the CLI. '--zuidstring' leaks the C# type name; '--new-name' is verbose; '--wait-ms' is a raw implementation unit. Use Spectre.Console.Cli's pipe syntax ([CommandOption("--new|--old")]) to accept both names, maintaining backward compatibility. This is a non-breaking change — the old flag names continue to work silently (no deprecation warning needed for flags, as they are consumed by scripts not displayed in help).
prerequisiteState: Stories 1–27 complete. Multiple commands use --zuidstring, account rename uses --new-name, and trace close uses --wait-ms. Spectre.Console.Cli supports multi-name options via [CommandOption("--name1|--name2")] syntax.
goal: After this story: --zuidstring is replaced by --zuid across all account commands that use it. --new-name is replaced by --to in account rename. --wait-ms is replaced by --drain-timeout in trace close. Old flag names still work via the pipe syntax — no deprecation warning needed for flag aliases (the old names just silently map to the same property). HELP.md and --help output show only the NEW flag names.
scope: Rename --zuidstring → --zuid in all affected Settings classes. Affected classes: AccountShowSettings, AccountSetDefaultSettings, AccountRemoveSettings, AccountRefreshSettings (formerly AccountReAuthSettings), AccountRenameSettings. Change the CommandOption attribute to [CommandOption("--zuid|--zuidstring")] and rename the backing property from ZuidString to Zuid (or Zuid). Update all usages of the ZuidString property inside ExecuteAsync methods to use the new property name.

Rename --new-name → --to in AccountRenameSettings. Change [CommandOption("--new-name")] to [CommandOption("--to|--new-name")]. Rename backing property NewName → To. Update all usages inside AccountRenameCommand.ExecuteAsync.

Rename --wait-ms → --drain-timeout in TraceCloseSettings (or TraceSessionCloseSettings depending on class name). Change [CommandOption("--wait-ms")] to [CommandOption("--drain-timeout|--wait-ms")]. Rename backing property WaitMs → DrainTimeout. Update all usages in TraceCloseCommand.ExecuteAsync.

Ensure --help output for affected commands shows the primary (new) flag names. Spectre.Console.Cli typically shows only the first option in the pipe as the primary and the rest as hidden aliases — verify this is the case by running --help.
Update docs/HELP.md (or defer to story 36) to show new flag names. If deferring to story 36, add a TODO comment here.
Update any tests that pass --zuidstring, --new-name, or --wait-ms flags to use the new names. Also verify that tests using old names still pass (backward compat test).
acceptanceCriteria: 'zapi account show --zuidstring <id>' continues to work (backward compat)
'zapi account show --zuid <id>' works with the new flag name
'zapi account rename --name old --new-name newname' still works (backward compat)
'zapi account show --help' shows --zuid as the primary flag (not --zuidstring)
'zapi trace close --help' shows --drain-timeout as the primary flag
contextForAgent: Read AccountCommands.cs to find all five Settings classes that use --zuidstring. Search for 'zuidstring' and 'new-name' and 'wait-ms' strings across the Commands folder. The Spectre.Console.Cli pipe syntax [CommandOption("--primary|--alias")] makes the first name the displayed one and the second a hidden alias — no extra code needed for the backward compat behavior. Verify by building and running '--help' after the changes.
openItems: Verify Spectre.Console.Cli pipe syntax behavior: does the --help output show only the first option name, or all names? If it shows all names, the HELP.md update in story 36 must manually exclude the old names.
